page.content:
General and president who fathers Hamilton in the war and the Cabinet.

How George Washington connects

  • Character: Alexander Hamilton — Washington makes Hamilton his aide and later his Treasury secretary.
  • Work: Hamilton (musical) — George Washington is the general and president of the musical.
  • Work: Cabinet Battle — Washington referees the Cabinet Battles.

What is George Washington?

George Washington is the commander who makes Hamilton his aide, later the president who runs the Cabinet Battles, and the father figure who sings Hamilton down from the field.

Key threads lead to Alexander Hamilton, Hamilton (musical) and Cabinet Battle.
